industry: Financial Services > Banks > Public Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: FY26: Exceptional item of ₹766.59 Cr booked in Q1FY26 related to disposal of investments in associates (RRB).
FY26: Recommended dividend of ₹18.25 per equity share.
Jewel loan book stands at ₹1.27 lakh Cr as of March 2026.
Bulk and CD deposits comprise 18-19% of total deposits.
Digital adoption rate in retail and agri reached 97%.
Bank booked ₹1,386.67 Cr under other income in Q2FY27 on account of listing of NSE shares (₹252.50 Cr realized gain on OFS, ₹1,134.17 Cr revaluation gain).
Held additional provision of ₹1,500 Cr towards anticipated Expected Credit Loss (ECL) impact in Q2FY27.
Bank's shareholding in ASREC came down to 30% from 38.26% post preferential allotment to LIC, Bank of India, and Union Bank of India on 16.05.2026.
Sep-2026: Domestic CASA ratio 39.36%, CD ratio 82.60%, cost of deposit 4.89% and yield on advances 8.17%.
Sep-2026: Priority sector advances were ₹2,57,647 Cr, 48.67% of ANBC against the 40% requirement.
Sep-2026: PCR including TWO was 98.22% and slippage ratio 0.69% against 0.79% a year earlier.
RBI's ISE 2026 assessed Mar-2026 credit RWA at ₹3,98,512 Cr against the bank's ₹3,76,320 Cr, after CCF was not applied to undrawn UCC exposures.
RBI assessed Mar-2026 Tier 2 capital at ₹4,234 Cr against the bank's ₹6,704 Cr, after ₹2,470 Cr was incorrectly reckoned as Tier 2.
The bank says it has factored RBI's ISE 2026 RWA and CRAR observations into its Sep-2026 calculations.
RAM constitutes around 67% of the total loan book.

timeline.summary: Indian Bank scheduled a post-earnings call with investors/analysts on **April 29, 2026**, led by **Shri Binod Kumar (MD & CEO)**, **Shri Ashutosh Choudhury (ED)**, **Shri Shiv Bajrang Singh (ED)**, **Shri Brajesh Kumar Singh (ED)**, and **Ms. Mini T M (ED)** to discuss Q4 FY’26 results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹17,488.5 Cr, net profit ₹3,115.2 Cr.
Indian Bank provided FY27 guidance with loan growth at 11-13% and NIM at 3.10-3.25% during its Q4FY26 earnings call.
Indian Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹3,462 Cr (+14.71% YoY) with GNPA at 1.61%, NNPA at 0.14% and domestic NIM at 3.42%.
Indian Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹3,462 Cr (+14.7% YoY) and raised its FY27 loan growth guidance to 13-14%.

2026-10-15: RBI's ISE 2026 assessment cut Indian Bank's Mar-2026 Total CRAR to 16.53% from 17.93% and CET-1 to 15.61%, citing ₹22,079 Cr of understated credit RWA and ₹2,470 Cr of Tier 2 capital disallowed, with no impact on FY26 net profit.
Indian Bank reported Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹3,462 crore, up 14.71% year-on-year.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for ₹5,000 Cr capital raise

watchlist.response: Management declined to give a specific number as guidelines were just released, but stated they can absorb it within 1-3 quarters.
Attributed to ₹400 Cr of MOC (Memorandum of Changes) which typically occurs in March.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for re-appointment of Independent Directors
